name: אֲזַנְיָה
summary: The father of Jeshua, a Levite who sealed the covenant in the days of Nehemiah (Neh 10:10). The name is the perfect of אָזַן with יָה: “Yahweh has given ear”, as he gave ear to the psalmist (Psa 77:2). Scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “And the Levites: Jeshua son of אֲזַנְיָה.”
“My voice to God, and he gave ear to me.”

note: TIPNR's Azaniah@Neh.10.9 is Neh 10:10 in the Hebrew numbering. The perfect reading is a reading of the form; the verb is otherwise only hiphil, and a qal 'he heard' is not attested.
